rationale: The 499-bps bid-ask spread alone (~$0.40) represents an immediate, structural cost that would require a significant move just to break even, making any directional edge near-impossible to capture on a $8 stock. Float of only 0.07M shares and relative volume at 0.23x normal levels means fills would be unreliable and slippage severe. With no news catalyst, price drifting well below both VWAPs, and no historical context to anchor a thesis, the risk-reward is unfavorable in either direction.
